entries.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
entries.description: Start with the form, then check what the title says about compartments, presets and accessories.

entries.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
entries.description: Capacity numbers on listings can measure different things. Check what the number measures before you compare two.

entries.description: Dishwasher-safe wording is in two of the three titles. Counter space is in none of them. Here is how to check both.

entries.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
entries.description: Multi-function claims are easy to count and hard to test. Ask what each number refers to and what is in the box.
